full_prompt_en: A monochrome pen-and-pencil caricature shows two suited men in an animated face-to-face confrontation on an otherwise blank page. The larger figure at left leans in with squared shoulders, a bulky jacket, prominent brow, and jutting nose. Both of his hands grip the slimmer man's shoulders, drawing the bodies into a compact knot at the center. The man on the right rocks backward, mouth opened wide in surprise, his thin neck and spiky hair amplifying the comic reaction. Their eyes are exaggerated and closely spaced across the narrow gap between their faces. Below the expressive heads, the bodies simplify into long trouser legs and lightly sketched shoes, with a few short ground strokes anchoring them to the white paper. Fine contour lines describe jacket seams, hands, facial folds, and hair, while angled pencil hatching sits under elbows and between the overlapping legs to suggest volume. The line weight changes from confident outer contours to lighter searching marks within the forms. No scenery or props compete with the exchange; generous white space surrounds the figures and concentrates attention on posture, expression, and the pressure of the hands. A small sketch-like mark near the bottom reinforces the impression of an informal cartoon drawing. The whole frame turns a brief human interaction into lively visual comedy through elastic anatomy and economical black marks.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅单色钢笔与铅笔漫画，在几乎空白的纸上描绘两名穿西装的男子面对面激烈交锋。左侧体型更大的人物肩膀方正，身体前倾，外套厚重，眉骨突出，鼻子向前伸出。他双手抓住较瘦男子的肩膀，使两人的身体在中央形成紧凑的一团。右边男子向后仰，惊讶地张大嘴，细长脖子和蓬乱尖翘的头发放大了滑稽反应。他们的眼睛被夸张处理，在两张脸之间狭窄的空隙里紧紧相对。富于表情的头部以下，身体简化为细长的裤腿和轻轻勾出的鞋子，几道短促地面线把他们固定在白纸上。细线描绘衣缝、双手、面部皱褶和头发；倾斜的铅笔排线落在手肘下方及重叠的腿之间，暗示体积。线条粗细从有力的外轮廓转向形体内部较浅、带探索感的痕迹。没有景物或道具与这场交流争夺注意力；宽裕的白色空处围绕人物，让视线集中在姿势、表情和双手的压力上。底部一个小小的草图式记号更强化了随手画出的漫画印象。整幅画凭借富于弹性的解剖夸张和节省的黑色笔迹，把短暂的人际互动化为生动的视觉喜剧。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome cartoon drawing uses crisp outer contours, light exploratory inner lines, and quick diagonal pencil hatching on clean white paper. A compact central knot of overlapping forms holds nearly all the detail; the surrounding field remains generously empty. Proportions are elastic, with enlarged expressive upper shapes tapering into simpler narrow lower shapes. Line weight shifts constantly, from firm curves at the silhouette to scratchier short strokes in shadowed recesses. Sparse ground marks establish balance without constructing a setting. The surface retains the immediacy of a hand sketch, including visible revisions and unfilled paper between marks. Tonal range is deliberately narrow: dark accents cluster at small points of contact, while most volume is suggested rather than shaded fully. The whole frame feels spontaneous, readable, and comic through lively gesture and economical line.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅单色漫画画作在干净白纸上运用清晰外轮廓、较轻的探索式内线，以及迅疾的斜向铅笔排线。中央紧凑且彼此重叠的一组形体容纳几乎所有细节，周围保留宽裕的空白。比例富于弹性，放大的上部表情形态向下收成更简单、细长的形状。线条粗细不断变化：剪影处是确定的曲线，阴影凹处则是更粗糙的短笔。稀疏的地面痕迹确立平衡，却不搭建具体环境。画面保留手绘草图的即时感，包括可见的修正痕迹和笔迹之间未填充的纸面。明暗范围刻意收窄：深色重点聚在少量接触位置，大部分体积靠暗示而非填满阴影形成。整幅画通过活泼的姿态和节省的线条，显得即兴、易读而有喜剧感。
theme_en: A comic confrontation between two suited men
theme_zh: 两位西装男子的漫画式争执
name: Ron Tandberg
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
